caseNameFull: Zurcher, Chief of Police of Palo Alto v. Stanford Daily and Bergna, District Attorney of Santa Clara County v. Stanford Daily

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 816.] Motion of Reporters Committee for Freedom of the Press et al. for leave to participate in oral argument as amici curiae denied. Motion of respondents to continue oral argument denied.
